You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: One Cake, Two Birthdays
start.text:
''A man is sitting on a flat rock near the water with a cake tin on his lap, staring at it like it owes him an apology.''

''It is a decent-looking cake. One layer, a little lopsided, but clearly made with care. He does not notice you until you are almost beside him.''

Oswin: ''startling'' Oh. Sorry. I was thinking.

''He looks back down at the tin.''

Oswin: Do you know the feeling when you have done everything right and it still turns out wrong?

wht_wnet_fworng.text:
Oswin: My two oldest friends. Nina and Bran. Both born the same day, same year, different mothers. They thought it was the funniest thing for years.

''He lifts the lid of the tin slightly, then sets it back.''

Oswin: I baked one cake. I always bake one cake. We all share it. Only this year Nina is in Mondstadt and Bran moved to Springvale, and I cannot be in both places. And I cannot cut this in half without it falling to pieces.

''He exhales.''

Oswin: One of them is going to have a birthday without a cake.

choices.label: I could bring it to one of them

Where_are_they_exactly.text:
Oswin: ''looking up'' You would do that?

''He considers this for a moment, then holds the tin out with both hands.''

Oswin: Nina is near the central square in Mondstadt. Bran is just off the main road into Springvale, hard to miss.

''He pauses.''

Oswin: I will get word to the other one myself. They will understand. Probably. ''quietly'' They will have to.

Oswin: Which way are you headed?

choices.label: I'm going through Mondstadt. I'll find Nina
Springvale is closer for me. I'll take it to Bran

to_nina.text:
''Oswin passes you the tin carefully, lid firmly on.''

Oswin: Nina. Thank you. She is going to be happy just that anyone showed up.

''He sits back, already looking like a man composing a difficult message in his head.''

Oswin: Don't let it tip.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Deliver the birthday cake to Nina in Mondstadt

continues.label: Go to Mondstadt City (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Deliver to Nina

to_bran.text:
''Oswin passes you the tin carefully, lid firmly on.''

Oswin: Bran. Good. He never expects anything, so this will completely undo him.

''He sits back, already looking like a man composing a difficult message in his head.''

Oswin: Don't let it tip.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Deliver the birthday cake to Bran in Springvale

continues.label: Go to Mondstadt City (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Deliver to Bran

nina.title: Delivered to Nina
nina.text:
''You find Nina near the square, a cup of tea cooling in her hand.''

Nina: ''staring at the tin'' Is that Oswin's cake?

''She takes it with both hands like it is made of glass.''

Nina: He sent it all the way here? He did not have to do that.

''She opens the lid and looks at it for a long moment. Then she closes it again, pressing her lips together.''

Nina: He absolutely had to do that.

''She tucks the tin under her arm and presses a folded note of coin into your hand.''

Nina: For your trouble. And tell him I said thank you. He knows what for.

bran.title: Delivered to Bran
bran.text:
''You spot Bran near the road into Springvale, leaning on a fence post.''

Bran: ''squinting'' What've you got there?

''You hold out the tin. He does not take it right away. He just stares at it.''

Bran: ...He baked it.

''Not a question.''

Bran: ''taking it slowly'' That ridiculous man. I told him last year not to bother. I said, Oswin, don't bother, and he...

''He stops. Looks at the tin.''

Bran: He always bothers.

''He presses some coin into your hand without looking away from the cake.''

Bran: Safe travels, traveller.
